h1: Your school data issafe with us
h2: 8 layers of security protecting your data
How we handle your school data

text_content: Security — How We Protect Your School Data | Skolify Skip to main content SF Skolify by Shivshakti Computer Academy Log in Start Free Trial 🔒 Security & Data Protection Your school data is safe with us We take data security seriously. Here's how we protect your information at every level — from browser to database. 🔐 HTTPS Encrypted 🏗️ Multi-Tenant Isolated 👥 4 Role Levels ☁️ Cloud Hosted 🛡️ Protection Layers 8 layers of security protecting your data Every aspect of the platform is built with security as the foundation — not as an afterthought. 🔐 Encrypted Connections All data transmitted between your browser and our servers is encrypted using TLS/HTTPS. No data ever travels in plain text. 🛡️ Secure Authentication Passwords hashed with bcrypt — never stored as plain text. JWT sessions auto-refresh every 30 seconds to detect subscription changes in real-time. 👥 Role-Based Access Four roles: Admin, Teacher, Student, Parent. Each role accesses only its permitted routes and data. Cross-role access is blocked at the middleware level. 🏗️ Tenant Data Isolation Each school's data is isolated using tenant IDs at the database query level. School A cannot access School B's data — ever. 📦 Plan-Based Module Lock Modules are locked based on subscription plan. Even direct URL access is blocked by middleware — no workarounds possible. ⏱️ Subscription Enforcement Expired subscription = immediate block on all features. Both UI and API return 403. Only the subscription renewal page remains accessible. ☁️ Cloud Infrastructure Hosted on modern cloud with MongoDB Atlas. Data encrypted at rest, automatic backups, uptime monitoring and geographic redundancy. 🧪 Trial Restrictions Trial accounts get Starter-level access only. Advanced modules like Fees, Exams, Library, HR remain locked until a paid plan is activated. ⚙️ Architecture Security at every layer Four independent layers of protection ensure your school data never leaks, even if one layer fails. 01 🌐 Browser / Client Next.js SSR — no sensitive data exposed to client. JWT tokens stored in HTTP-only cookies. All pages server-rendered for security. 02 ⚙️ Edge Middleware Every request validated — checks authentication, user role, subscription status, plan tier, and module access before any page loads. 03 🔌 API Layer All API endpoints double-check authorization. Even if middleware is bypassed, API returns 403. Double protection at every level. 04 🗄️ Database MongoDB Atlas with full tenant isolation. Every query is scoped to the authenticated school's tenant ID. Encryption at rest enabled. Defense in Depth: Each layer independently validates the request. Bypassing one layer does not grant access — all layers must pass. 📋 Data Practices How we handle your school data Clear, honest commitments about what we do and don't do with your data. 🚫 We do not sell, share, or trade school data with any third party 👁️ School data is only accessible by the school's own admin and authorized staff 🔑 Superadmin access is limited to platform management — never to individual school data 💳 Payment information is handled by Razorpay — we never store card/UPI details 📤 You can request data export or deletion by contacting our support team 🗓️ We retain data for the duration of your subscription + 90 days grace period 📧 We send transactional emails only — no marketing spam without your consent 🇮🇳 India Compliant Data stored within compliant cloud infrastructure. Governed by Indian law. 💳 PCI Compliant Payments Payments via Razorpay — fully PCI DSS compliant. We never touch card data. 🔄 Regular Audits Security practices reviewed regularly. Updates deployed as new threats emerge. Early Access Open Ready to simplify your school operations? Set up your school in minutes — no installation, no credit card.
